title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Auditorium on 1968-08-23

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of an iconic 1968 Shrine show with a smoking Dark Star → St. Stephen → The Eleven sequence and a standout Alligator jam.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as headphone‑friendly, clean and well‑balanced – a true soundboard (sbd) source that even improves on earlier releases. Musically the concert is hailed as a peak moment of the 1968 Shrine run, highlighted by an epic Dark Star/Eleven medley, an unforgettable Alligator jam, and strong early tracks, with only the incomplete Eleven noted as a minor blemish.

ai_rating.rationale: Over ten enthusiastic 5‑star reviews emphasize both superb soundboard quality and exceptional performance; only a few minor criticisms (cut in The Eleven, occasional tempo slip) keep the rating just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean mix described as headphone‑friendly; track divisions fixed and sector boundaries intact. Minor issue: The Eleven is incomplete due to a cut, but this does not affect overall clarity.

standout_songs: Dark Star > St. Stephen > The Eleven
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening with incomparable first four tracks, a powerful mid‑show Dark Star/Eleven sequence, and a high‑energy Alligator jam that caps the performance; overall pacing is praised as both imaginative and cohesive.

band_member_comments.Phil: Starts the Eleven jam a couple of bars too early, according to one reviewer.
band_member_comments.Bob: Sings an alternate lyric in Alligator ('The name on the billboard says Avalon').
